# Kilo-Kit > **The Autonomous Cognitive Cortex & Governed Agency Substrate for AI Coding Agents** Kilo-Kit is an enterprise-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and supervisor engine that transforms raw LLM coding assistants (**GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Gemini CLI**) into disciplined, self-correcting software engineers. It enforces grounded diagnostic probing, Tree-of-Thoughts DAG planning, cross-session memory via SQLite FTS5 BM25, and runtime supervisor guardrails to eliminate blind code edits and infinite loop thrashing. [Quick Start (30s)](#-quick-start-in-30-seconds) • [Why Kilo-Kit?](#-why-kilo-kit) • [Architecture](#-architecture--c4-protocol) • [IDE Setup](#-ide-integration-guide) • [Core Capabilities](#-core-capabilities) • [Tools Reference](#-mcp-tools-suite-24-tools) • [Skills Catalog](#-curated-skills-catalog-180-skills) --- ## 💡 Why Kilo-Kit? ### The Crisis of Unbounded AI Agency Modern LLMs are exceptional code generators, but when given autonomous tools without structural guardrails, they suffer from critical operational failure modes: * **Blind Mutations (Ungrounded Edits):** Agents modify files without reading their contents, dependencies, or type contracts, introducing silent architectural regressions. * **The Infinite Thrashing Loop:** When a test or build fails, the agent repeats the exact same failing edit 5 to 10 times in a row until credits or context windows are exhausted. * **Context Collapse & Lost-in-the-Middle:** Unbounded test dumps and terminal traces inject 50,000+ tokens of raw noise, causing severe attention degradation and hallucinated refactoring. * **Agent Amnesia:** Every new session starts from zero—past mistakes, verified bug fixes, and architectural decisions are completely forgotten across conversations. ### The Solution: Governed Autonomy Kilo-Kit acts as an intelligent supervisor sitting between the AI agent and your codebase, establishing a balance of **Macro-Determinism** (strict safety boundaries) with **Micro-Agency** (unconstrained local implementation freedom): * **🛡️ Pre-Flight Grounding Lock:** File modifications are physically rejected at the protocol level if the agent has not inspected the target file during the active session. * **🛑 Circuit Breaker Tripwire:** Automatically halts execution after 3 consecutive identical actions or repeated failures, forcing structured root-cause analysis. * **✂️ Smart Truncation (20/80 Rule):** Retains critical command flags, dynamically scans and preserves intermediate exceptions (`FAIL`, `TypeError`, `panic`), and keeps final stack traces while streaming raw verbose output safely to disk. * **🧠 Persistent BM25 Memory:** Every architectural decision, verified solution, and reflection is indexed in embedded SQLite FTS5 for sub-millisecond retrieval across future sessions. --- ## ⚡ Quick Start (in 30 seconds) ### 1. Zero-Install Instant Setup Run Kilo-Kit directly with `npx` to automatically detect and configure all installed IDEs on your machine: ```bash npx @vodailocz/kilo-kit-mcp setup ``` Or install globally for zero-latency local execution: ```bash npm install -g @vodailocz/kilo-kit-mcp kilo-kit-setup --local ``` ### 2. Verify System Health Run the 18-point empirical diagnostic suite: ```bash kilo-kit-doctor ``` ```text 🏥 Kilo-Kit System Health Doctor [HEALTHY] ✅ PASS Node.js Runtime: Node.js meets requirement (>= 20.0.0). ✅ PASS CLI Global Binaries: All CLI binaries resolved in PATH. ✅ PASS SQLite Persistence: SQLite verified (14 tables, FTS5 BM25 active, integrity: ok). ✅ PASS Skill Library: Successfully indexed all 180/180 skills in repository. ✅ PASS Client: GitHub Copilot: Configured in ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json [Local linked binary] ✅ PASS Client: Cursor IDE: Configured in ~/.cursor/mcp.json [Local linked binary] ✅ PASS Client: Claude Code: Configured in ~/.claude.json [Local linked binary] ✅ PASS MCP Server Runtime: All 24 tools registered; functional probe executed successfully. Summary: Kilo-Kit Doctor: 18/18 checks passed. Overall Status: HEALTHY ``` --- ## 🏛️ Architecture & C4 Protocol Kilo-Kit establishes a strict separation of concerns between **Cognitive Reasoning (Cortex)**, **Supervisor Guardrails (Sentinel)**, and **Safe I/O Execution (Limbs)**: ``` [ Host AI Agent: Cursor / Copilot / Windsurf / Claude / Gemini ] │ stdio / JSON-RPC ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ KILO-SENTINEL SUPERVISOR MIDDLEWARE │ │ • Pre-Flight Grounding Lock • Loop & Thrashing Tripwire│ │ • 20/80 Smart Log Truncation • Step Budget Enforcer │ └──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘ │ ┌──────────────────┴──────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────┐ │ KILO COGNITIVE CORTEX │ │ SAFE EXECUTION │ │ • 4-Tier Adaptive Gating │ │ • Atomic File Writers │ │ • Tree-of-Thoughts DAG │ │ • AST-Safe File Editors │ │ • 5-Whys Diagnostic Engine │ │ • Filtered Command Exec │ │ • 180 Curated Skills │ └──────────────────────────┘ └──────────────┬──────────────┘ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ SQLITE ATOMIC MEMORY │ │ • FTS5 BM25 Search Engine │ │ • Self-Authoring Skills │ │ • Cross-Session Knowledge │ └─────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### The C4 5-Gate Lifecycle Every non-trivial coding task proceeds through a verifiable state machine: ```mermaid flowchart LR G1["Gate 1: Grounded Probe
• BM25 Memory Recall
• Exploratory Read"] G2["Gate 2: Cognitive Reasoning
• 3-Option ToT DAG
• Adversarial Grill
• 5-Whys Root Cause"] G3["Gate 3: Approval
• Plan Locked
• Skills Injected"] G4["Gate 4: Execution
• Defense-in-Depth
• Sentinel Guarded"] G5["Gate 5: 4D QA
• Empirical Tests
• SQLite Reflection"] G1 --> G2 G2 --> G3 G3 --> G4 G4 --> G5 G4 -.->|3x Loop Detected| Breaker["🛑 Circuit Breaker
(Supervised Reset)"] Breaker -.-> G1 ``` 1. **Gate 1 (Grounded Probe):** Recalls relevant past lessons via BM25 ranking and performs read-only codebase reconnaissance. 2. **Gate 2 (Cognitive Reasoning):** Formulates a 3-option trade-off hypothesis DAG (`kilo_think_step`) and conducts adversarial stress-testing (`kilo_grill_plan`). 3. **Gate 3 (Approval & Skills):** Locks the implementation plan and injects domain-specific expert workflows (`kilo_get_skill`). 4. **Gate 4 (Guarded Execution):** Performs surgical code edits backed by atomic writes and syntax validation. 5. **Gate 5 (Empirical QA & Reflection):** Validates changes with automated test runners and Playwright before persisting lessons into SQLite memory. --- ## 💻 IDE Integration Guide Kilo-Kit integrates natively into any MCP-compliant editor or CLI agent. | Client | Configuration Path | Command Configuration | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Cursor IDE** | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` | `{"mcpServers": {"kilo-kit": {"command": "kilo-kit-mcp"}}}` | | **GitHub Copilot** | `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json` | `{"mcpServers": {"kilo-kit": {"command": "kilo-kit-mcp"}}}` | | **Claude Code & Desktop** | `~/.claude.json` | `{"mcpServers": {"kilo-kit": {"command": "kilo-kit-mcp"}}}` | | **Windsurf IDE** | `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json` | `{"mcpServers": {"kilo-kit": {"command": "kilo-kit-mcp"}}}` | | **Google Antigravity & Gemini CLI** | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp_config.json` | `{"mcpServers": {"kilo-kit": {"command": "kilo-kit-mcp"}}}` | | **OpenCode** | `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` | `{"mcp": {"kilo-kit": {"type": "local", "command": ["kilo-kit-mcp"]}}}` | --- ## ⚡ Core Capabilities ### 1. 🚦 4-Tier Adaptive Task Gating Replaces rigid one-size-fits-all rituals with task-calibrated execution paths: * **Tier 0 (Inspect):** Read-only exploration, file searches, regex grep. Immediately ready with zero gate friction. * **Tier 1 (Micro-fix):** Single-line bug fixes, typo corrections, linter remediations. Fast-path authorization with lightweight validation. * **Tier 2 (Feature):** Multistage feature implementation and refactoring. Requires Tree-of-Thoughts DAG planning and skill injection. * **Tier 3 (Critical):** Database migrations, auth workflows, cross-cutting architectural changes. Enforces adversarial red-team grilling and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. ### 2. 🔍 SQLite FTS5 with BM25 Lexical Ranking Persistent memory engineered for instant recall: * Sub-millisecond full-text retrieval across thousands of past trajectories, decisions, and reflections. * Native BM25 relevance ranking surfaces verified past bug fixes before planning starts. * Prevents agents from repeating mistakes made in previous sessions or branches. ### 3. ✍️ Self-Authoring Skills & Autonomous Evolution Turns every hard-won bug fix into persistent institutional knowledge: * Upon resolving complex edge cases, Gate 5 reflections automatically synthesize reusable `SKILL.md` instruction files. * New skills are dynamically indexed and discoverable across all connected agents via `kilo_get_skill`. ### 4. 🛡️ Kilo-Sentinel Loop & Thrashing Tripwire Real-time supervisor middleware that protects developer credits and context: * Blocks file modifications on unread files (enforces grounding). * Detects repeated identical tool calls and edit thrashing, cutting off execution before runaway token burns occur. * Offloads complete execution transcripts to disk while enforcing concise,
